messages.text:
What it is: Dispositioned .swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-*.md files are archived instead of sitting undeleted forever
What it solves: `.swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-*.md` is the channel the operator uses to
hand the coordinator a directive or scope request that isn't itself a
backlog item yet (e.g. `.swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-bl307-seed-race.md`,
the source of BL-310). No role prompt documents what happens to the file
once it has …
How it works: An INTAKE-*.md file whose corresponding ticket is already in backlog/done/ is moved into .swarmforge/operator/archive/
